_doc: Furnishing variants. Each variant removes objects from the furnished flat. An object goes when its 'flat_cat' custom property (set in furnish.py / build_flat.py, exported to scene.json as 'cat') is in 'remove_cats', or when its name matches one of 'remove_patterns' (Python regex, searched in the Blender object name = Unreal actor label). Lights are removed by the same rules. Categories: arch, bath_fitting, switch, mirror, wall_finish, kitchen_fitted, appliance, wardrobe, false_ceiling, light_fitting, fan, loose_furniture, bed, study, tv, soft_furnishing, curtain, decor, plant, balcony_furniture, context. The 'keep_note' fields are for the docs only. Confirm with the user what their builder hands over before building SemiFurnished.

SemiFurnished.title: Semi-furnished
SemiFurnished.keep_note: Builder fit-out stays: modular kitchen (cabinets, counter, sink, hob, chimney), wardrobes, false ceiling with downlights and coves, wall lights, pendants, fans, bathroom fittings, TV wall unit.

Unfurnished.title: Without furniture
Unfurnished.keep_note: Bare shell: architecture, doors, windows, railings, floor and wall finishes, bathroom fittings, mirrors, switch plates. Lit by daylight only (sun and sky); the corridor light outside the entrance stays.
